adopted: Use the accepted ProjectRegistry mapping on reopen to establish the project id; do not introduce a second project identity registry.

Reuse U04 selected-memory authority and provenance policy as the caller contract; freshness.ts does not call the U04 reader or read Native notes itself. Formal history input remains an experience lead.

Implement only the U08 freshness gap locally: compare a prior snapshot with a newly observed Git HEAD and selected evidence raw hashes. Supersession requires an explicitly verified replacement.
